decisions.summary: Bundle Story/Spec/Architecture SSOT docs with the single-function implementation and its test in one PR instead of splitting by lane.
decisions.reason: The split plan proposes 3 lanes (requirements-ssot, runtime-behavior, misc-follow-up) but this Story is one small coherent measurement-layer fix confined to src/architecture-conformance.js and its test; the SSOT docs exist only to describe that one change. Splitting would force reviewers to read the architecture/spec docs in a PR with no code to check them against, and the code PR in a PR with no rationale. Prior VibePro self-dogfood stories (e.g. story-vibepro-target-architecture-conformance PR #378, story-vibepro-infra-story-dependency-cut PR #387) bundled [REDACTED:cb70e244eab2] registration in a single PR for the same reason. .vibepro/config.json's story-catalog entry is a required registration step for this same Story, not an unrelated change.
